title: Memberships
nextBillingDate: Start on the next billing date
alignmentHelp: For an existing household, use its next billing date so the family shares one invoice.
assignmentHelp: Assigning records the billing instructions. A pending membership activates after payment is confirmed.
confirmCancel: Cancel this membership? The commitment date stays on record.
priceHelp: Enter this member's price. It applies from the next billing date.
invalidPrice: Enter a valid price, with no more decimal places than the currency uses.
nothingToChange: Enter a price different from the current one.
freezeHelp: The next cycle is skipped. Leave the resume date blank to freeze until staff resume it.
resumeHelp: Choose the next billing date. The skipped cycle will stay skipped.
error: Could not load memberships. Please try again.
noPlans: Add an active plan in the billing catalog first.
noOtherPlans: There is no other active plan in this membership's currency.
nowNotActive: Only an active membership can change plan now.
nowIntervalChange: A plan with another billing interval starts on a billing date.
keepsPrice: The membership keeps its current price until {date}. Nothing is charged or refunded.
chargedNow: An invoice for {total} is issued now, covering {days} of {periodDays} days left in this period, and charged to the saved card.
whenActive: The change applies when the membership is next billed as active.
commitmentBlocks: The commitment runs until {date}. To switch to a cheaper plan before then, enter a reason.
overrideReason: Reason for switching before the commitment ends
agreementReminder: If the new plan needs a new agreement, open the member's Waivers and agreements tab and collect the signature.
planChangedInvoice: Plan changed. An invoice for the difference was issued.
confirmCancelChange: Cancel the scheduled change? The membership keeps its current plan and price.
priceReplacesScheduled: A new price is scheduled for {date}. A price entered here replaces it.
priceBlockedBySwitch: A plan change is scheduled for {date}. It sets the price on that date, so cancel the change before changing the price.
switchFailed: Could not change the plan. Please try again.
switchStale: This membership changed. It has been reloaded; review it and try again.
reason_plan_inactive: That plan is no longer active.
reason_same_plan: The membership is already on that plan.
reason_cancelled: A cancelled membership can't change plan.
reason_commitment: The commitment hasn't ended. Enter a reason to switch anyway.
reason_not_active: Only an active membership can change plan now.
reason_interval_change: A plan with another billing interval starts on a billing date.
reason_period_not_billed: The current period wasn't billed at the current price, so it can't change plan now. Use the next billing date.
reason_tax_change: The two plans carry different taxes, so an upgrade starts on the next billing date.
reason_switch_scheduled: A plan change is scheduled. Cancel it before changing the price.
